  [Enhanced Local-in             ]  CRITICAL: Local-in CRITICAL: WAN interface 'wan1' has management access (http, https, ping, snmp, ssh, telnet) enabled AND has NO local-in-policy restricting source IPs. Any IP on the internet can attempt to reach FortiGate management. This is a CRITICAL management plane exposure. Fix:
  config firewall local-in-policy
      edit 1
          set intf wan1
          set srcaddr <your-admin-subnet>
          set service HTTPS SSH
          set action accept
      next
      edit 2
          set intf wan1
          set srcaddr all
          set service ALL
          set action deny
      next
  end
